graph.name: Accenture Circulus Supply Chain Solution
graph.categories: Blockchain, IoT, Machine Learning, Supply Chain
graph.notes: Accenture's Circulus Supply Chain solution uses IoT sensors, AWS Lambda, Hyperledger Fabric on EKS, DynamoDB off-chain storage, S3 data lake, and SageMaker predictive models to improve coffee supply chain transparency and farmer incentives.

nodes.name: IOT
nodes.notes: Ingests environmental data (e.g., temperature) from farm sensors and shipping containers.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Evaluates sensor thresholds and invokes application backend.

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Application Load Balancer distributing traffic to Hyperledger Fabric container nodes.

nodes.name: BLOCKCHAIN
nodes.notes: Amazon EKS cluster running Hyperledger Fabric containerized blockchain nodes and smart contracts.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores off-chain ledger data to enable fast queries and visualization.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Aggregates historical off-chain transaction logs for long-term analytics.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Builds predictive ML models to forecast produce spoilage, delays, and supply disruptions.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Triggers push notifications and alerts when smart contract parameters are breached.

nodes.name: CLOUDWATCH
nodes.notes: Monitors EKS blockchain container nodes for health, performance, and auto-scaling.

nodes.name: KEYS
nodes.notes: FIPS-compliant Hardware Security Module managing cryptographic keys for blockchain transactions.

nodes.name: Users / Drivers
nodes.notes: Receives real-time route change and threshold breach notifications on mobile devices.

edges.notes: IoT sensor threshold trigger invokes Lambda function.
Lambda forwards verified transaction request to ALB.
ALB routes requests to Hyperledger Fabric containers on EKS.
Blockchain writes off-chain state and ledger data to DynamoDB in real-time.
DynamoDB exports off-chain dataset into Amazon S3 storage.
S3 supplies historical data to SageMaker for predictive analytics modeling.
Smart contract event triggers SNS notifications on policy or condition failure.
SNS delivers real-time notifications to drivers and operational users.
CloudWatch continuously monitors EKS cluster health and triggers auto-scaling.
Blockchain nodes query CloudHSM for cryptographic key operations.
